transcript: Stop spending time with people who don't make you feel good. Stop giving second chances to people who never gave you a first try. Stop spending your days recovering from conversations that left you feeling small. Stop convincing yourself that they're not that bad when you always leave feeling worse. Find your people. My friend, your energy is sacred. Every conversation leaves an imprint on your nervous system. Some people leave you lighter, clearer, more yourself. Others leave you tired, confused, and questioning your worth. If you need days to recover from someone's words, that is not growth. That is self-abandonment. Your body always knows the truth before your mind tries to explain it away. In the old teachings we say, what drains you is not meant to stay. What brings anxiety is not love. And what repeatedly hurts you is not a lesson. It is a signal. You do not need to cut people off with anger. You do not need to justify your boundaries. You simply need to listen to how you feel after you leave. Peace is not found by trying harder. Peace is found by choosing better. And if you feel stuck, tired, or unsure how to let go without guilt, I created a gentle path to guide you back to yourself. The 30-day healing journey is a daily practice to calm your nervous system, release emotional weight, and rebuild inner safety. One day at a time. You don't need to fix yourself. You need to come home to yourself. You can join through the link in my profile.
